# Vintage Vogue India

> Curated 1-of-1 Japanese archival thrift and authenticated western wear flagship studio. Hand-sourced from Tokyo, Osaka, and American flea markets. Every specimen is single-inventory, steam sanitized, and flat-laid tape measured to 0.25-inch precision in our Kota, Rajasthan workshop.

## Studio & Identity

## Archival Collections (Drop #24 — The Autumn Nomad)
- [1994 Japanese Boxy Worker Shirt](https://vintagevogue.in/#boxy-shirts): 100% sandwashed double-weave raw cotton with contrast hand-guided chainstitch embroidery. 1-of-1 specimen (₹3,499).
- [1996 Type II Selvedge Trucker Jacket](https://vintagevogue.in/#denim-workwear): 14oz Okayama shuttle-loomed indigo denim with genuine sun-faded whisker patina and copper shank hardware (₹4,299).
- [1988 Distressed Lambskin Aviator Bomber](https://vintagevogue.in/#leather-jackets): Full-grain vegetable-tanned lambskin flight jacket with Talon brass hardware and quilted viscose lining (₹8,499).

- [Reworked 70s Prairie Floral Tiered Midi Dress](https://vintagevogue.in/#dresses-corsets): Authentic 1976 bohemian calico cotton with adjustable ribbon corset tie back (₹3,899).
- [1994 Sonic Youth Tour Heavyweight Tee](https://vintagevogue.in/#vintage-tees): Single-stitch hem memorabilia with authentic cracked plastisol graphic and sun fade (₹3,699).
- [8-Wale Sandstone Corduroy Utility Overshirt](https://vintagevogue.in/#boxy-shirts): Heavyweight cotton velvet corduroy in signature autumn tobacco rust tone (₹3,299).

## Verification & Logistics Policy
- **1-of-1 Specimen Guarantee**: Every piece in our catalog is an authentic single-quantity thrift discovery. Once claimed by a patron, it is permanently locked and never restocked.
- **Sanitization Protocol**: All garments undergo organic eucalyptus mist deep-cleaning and pressurized dry steam sanitization in our Kota studio prior to dispatch.
- **Measurement Standards**: We provide four flat-laid tape measurements for every garment (Pit-to-Pit chest, total length, shoulder width, sleeve length) to eliminate sizing confusion.
- **Payment & Security**: Transactions are settled in Indian Rupees (₹) via Bharat UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), NetBanking, Credit/Debit cards, or Cash on Delivery.
